phases.name: guideline single source and drift gate
wiki seeded and linted
documentation automation
phases.command: php artisan wiki:audit && test -f wiki/_meta/audit.json && test -f .claude/commands/document.md

phases.name: zero-key boot guard
command parity gate
first-party skill packs
documentation
phases.command: rg -q 'Agent and AI-native' FEATURES.md && test -f .ai/rules/docs.md && rg -q 'wiki' README.md

phases.name: full gate green
LSP plugins enabled with binaries on PATH
phases.command: command -v intelephense && command -v typescript-language-server && rg -q "php-lsp@claude-plugins-official" .claude/settings.json && rg -q "typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official" .claude/settings.json

phases.name: guard-gates asks before an agent edits a mutation patch
each worktree gets its own database
phases.command: test -x bin/worktree-setup && rg -q worktree-setup .githooks/post-checkout && rg -q testing_ tests/bootstrap.php

phases.name: shared list URLs are a fixed point
a fresh clone resolves every slash command and subagent the agent kit names
workflow skills start without being named
a session's second app file is refused until a contract is frozen
the commit gate is fast and scoped to what is staged
the push gate skips a tree it already verified
the PR auditor workflow is built and off by default
hook, CI and switch-on steps are documented
phases.command: php artisan wiki:lint && rg -q 'Switching CI on' wiki/decisions/ci-quality.md

phases.name: todo state manages itself: feat commits carry a todo item and pushes recheck statuses in the background
phases.command: bash bin/prove-todo-gate.sh && rg -q 'recheck-todo' README.md && rg -q 'recheck-todo' FEATURES.md && rg -q 'recheck-todo' wiki/operations/contributing.md

phases.name: Codex hooks resolve from the checkout they run in, not one machine path
the guidelines carry the anti-yes-man rules and AGENTS.md is rendered from them
phases.command: rg -q 'Agreement is not the default' .ai/guidelines/general.blade.php AGENTS.md && php artisan test --compact --filter=GuidelinesAreCurrent

phases.name: raw SQL built from concatenation or interpolation fails the build
no personal-plugin comment prefix is left in the starter
phases.command: ! rg -qi ponytail app bin config scripts

phases.name: agents mark a shortcut with Known limit: and the build fails on a personal-plugin prefix
phases.command: rg -q 'Known limit:' .ai/guidelines/general.blade.php AGENTS.md && php artisan test --compact --filter='project comment prefix'

phases.name: agents read the database rule and load the database-design skill before a schema change
phases.command: ! rg -q 'disable-model-invocation' .ai/skills/database-design/SKILL.md && rg -q '^name: database-design$' .ai/skills/database-design/SKILL.md && rg -q -F "'.ai/rules/database.md' => 'database-design'," app/Console/Commands/AgentsContextCommand.php && rg -q '"database-design"' boost.json && rg -q -F 'load the `database-design` skill before you plan or write a schema change' AGENTS.md && rg -q -F '.ai/skills/database-design/SKILL.md' database/migrations/AGENTS.md && [ -f .claude/skills/database-design/SKILL.md ] && php artisan agents:context --check

phases.name: every foreign key column and every organization_id column has an index that leads with it, checked against the PostgreSQL catalog
cache and Redis use follows the cache rule: finite expiry, organization cache keys, three Redis databases, no flush or KEYS from application code
every migration runs up, down and up again on PostgreSQL, SQLite and MySQL
Sessions pinned to UTC, no time zone column types, and no unique rule or slug lookup that skips soft-deleted rows
An email address is stored in lower case and lower-cased before every lookup that compares it
ValidEmail matches the whole value and fails a non-string, the egress host is compared without case, and the sign-in forms accept an address typed with capitals
ValidEmail accepts an apostrophe and a punycode top-level domain, and the profile form holds a changed address to the same rule as sign-up
